card.name: Impaired before kidney or liver function
card.fires_on: The word impaired (or its piece 'aired', or 'impairment of') right after 'patients with' and just before renal, kidney or liver function. It appears in dosing and warning sections.

modes.label: Impaired after patients with
modes.description: The word impaired follows 'patients with' and precedes renal or hepatic function.
modes.example: Methotrexate elimination is reduced in patients with<< impaired>> renal functions, ascites, or ple

modes.label: Split word in headings
modes.description: The word is split partway, on 'aired', in a heading about renal or kidney function.
modes.example: Table 2 Dosage Recommendations for Adult Patients with Imp<<aired>> Renal Function Valganciclov

modes.label: Impairment of organ function
modes.description: The noun impairment followed by 'of' before liver function.
modes.example: marked impairment<< of>> liver functions or with severe respiratory distress where

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict kidney and liver words (kidneys, liver, hepatic) next.
card.plain: It spots the phrase 'impaired' in 'patients with impaired...' and expects the kidney or liver to come next.
